nodes.label: SYSTEM_PROMPT (shared by 3 providers)
nodes.rationale: Single prompt shared by claude_code, claude and ollama providers so all produce the same breakdown rules.

nodes.label: tareas.db (user's real plan, JSON persistence)
nodes.rationale: Contains the user's real plan: must not be deleted.

nodes.label: Claude Code non-interactive provider (no API key)
nodes.norm_label: claude code non-interactive provider (no api key)
nodes.rationale: Lets Pro/Team/Enterprise users use Claude via their logged-in Claude Code session without an API key.

nodes.label: Ollama local AI (7B+ recommended)
nodes.rationale: 3B models work but produce worse breakdowns.

nodes.label: Rule: dates only from Configuration (default today .. end of month)
nodes.norm_label: rule: dates only from configuration (default today .. end of month)
nodes.rationale: Dates in input text are ignored; empty config means start today, due last day of current month.

nodes.label: No tests; validate with short .venv scripts
nodes.norm_label: no tests; validate with short .venv scripts

nodes.label: Rule: 1 story point = one meaningful deliverable
nodes.norm_label: rule: 1 story point = one meaningful deliverable
nodes.rationale: Avoid repeated/trivial tasks; steps go in the description, not as separate tasks.

nodes.label: Rule: title format PROYECTO - descripcion - info adicional
nodes.norm_label: rule: title format proyecto - descripcion - info adicional
nodes.rationale: Project prefix is the exact epic name, keeping titles self-describing in Jira.

nodes.label: Rule: task has only its epic as parent, no labels sent
nodes.community_name: Subida a Jira: campos y reglas
nodes.norm_label: rule: task has only its epic as parent, no labels sent
nodes.rationale: Decided by the user: Jira tasks carry only their epic as parent; labels are never sent.

nodes.label: Push updates existing issues with jira_key instead of duplicating
nodes.community_name: Subida a Jira: campos y reglas
nodes.norm_label: push updates existing issues with jira_key instead of duplicating
nodes.rationale: Already-uploaded items (PRJ-123 key) are updated, not duplicated; removing from plan does not delete in Jira.

nodes.label: Optional field fallback when Jira rejects a field
nodes.community_name: Subida a Jira: campos y reglas
nodes.norm_label: optional field fallback when jira rejects a field
nodes.rationale: If Jira rejects an optional field (priority, story points, labels), the issue is created without it and a warning is shown.
